title: Graph State Persistence
summary: This module defines abstract and concrete mechanisms for persisting the state of graph runs. It includes an abstract base class for state management, along with file-based and in-memory implementations to track graph execution progress and enable recovery.

nodes.label: Define Persistence Interface
nodes.title: BaseStatePersistence
nodes.description: Abstract base class specifying methods for storing and retrieving graph run states and node execution details, including snapshots and run recording.

nodes.label: Persist to JSON File
nodes.title: FileStatePersistence
nodes.description: Concrete implementation that stores graph run snapshots as JSON in a specified file. It uses Pydantic TypeAdapters for serialization and includes a file-based locking mechanism for concurrency.

nodes.label: Persist In-Memory
nodes.title: FullStatePersistence
nodes.description: Concrete implementation that stores graph run snapshots in a Python list in memory. It offers an option for deep copying state and nodes to ensure immutability of historical records.

nodes.label: Graph Run State
nodes.title: StateT
nodes.description: Represents the current data and context of the graph execution at a specific point in time, captured during snapshots.

nodes.label: Graph Node Execution
nodes.title: BaseNode
nodes.description: Represents a single step or operation within the graph. Its execution status, start time, and duration are tracked by persistence mechanisms.

nodes.label: JSON File Storage
nodes.title: Persistence JSON File
nodes.description: An external JSON file used by FileStatePersistence to store serialized graph snapshots, enabling durable storage across application restarts.

nodes.label: Graph Execution Engine
nodes.title: Graph
nodes.description: The core engine responsible for executing graph nodes. It utilizes persistence mechanisms to manage run state, track progress, and support recovery or iteration from saved states.

groups.label: Persistence Interfaces
groups.title: Core Persistence Interfaces
groups.description: Defines the abstract contract for how graph run states are managed and persisted.

groups.label: Persistence Implementations
groups.title: Concrete Persistence Strategies
groups.description: Provides different strategies for storing and retrieving graph execution snapshots.

groups.label: Managed Data
groups.title: Graph Execution Data
groups.description: The core data structures whose states and execution details are managed by the persistence layer.

groups.label: External Storage
groups.title: External Data Storage
groups.description: External resources used by persistence mechanisms for durable storage.

groups.label: Consumers
groups.title: Persistence Consumers
groups.description: Modules or components that interact with and rely on the persistence mechanisms.
